name: Vespid Dynamics Atmospheric Sampling Drone ASD-5
product_name: Vespid Dynamics Atmospheric Sampling Drone ASD-5
description: A weather-resistant drone equipped with a comprehensive atmospheric analysis suite for environmental monitoring, contamination assessment, and air quality mapping. The ASD-5 samples air at altitude and analyzes particulates, chemical compounds, biological agents, and radiation levels in real-time, creating 3D atmospheric maps that show contamination plumes, clean air corridors, and threat concentrations. The drone can operate in adverse weather conditions including rain, high winds, and extreme temperatures, making it suitable for emergency response and contamination zone assessment.

specifications.info: chemicals; biological agents; radiation; 60 km/h winds; -20°C to +50°C

story_hooks: An ASD-5 mapping a Tier 2 district detected an unknown biological agent at altitude that ground-level sensors had not registered — something is being dispersed from above, and the source is not visible.

ASD-5 atmospheric data has revealed that air quality in a specific district varies on a schedule that correlates with shift changes at a factory 5 km away — the factory is venting contaminants during off-hours when monitoring is reduced.

physical_description.visual_profile: A sleek hexacopter with a prominent central sensor pod. Six carbon-fiber arms extend radially from a reinforced polymer hub, each tipped with brushless motor units. The design suggests purposeful durability—no aesthetic flourishes, only functional geometry. The sensor pod dominates the undercarriage, bristling with intake vents, optical windows, and sampling ports.
physical_description.dimensions: 40 cm rotor-to-rotor span; central body approximately 15 cm diameter; sensor pod adds 8 cm vertical depth
physical_description.weight_description: 2.5 kg total—handheld but requires two-handed launch and recovery; easy to shoulder-carry via integrated webbing loops
physical_description.primary_material: Carbon-fiber reinforced polymer frame with anodized aluminum motor mounts and sensor housing; weather-sealed composite sensor pod
physical_description.finish: Matte charcoal body with brushed aluminum accents; sensor pod has a frosted polycarbonate observation panel revealing internal analysis cells
physical_description.color_scheme: Gunmetal gray primary with high-visibility neon orange rotor blade tips and status indicator strips along the motor arms; Vespid Dynamics branding in white sans-serif font on dual sides
physical_description.interface_elements: Flush-mount LED array (green/amber/red status lights) along the front hub; micro SD card slot and USB-C connector recessed under weatherproof flip panel; four control buttons for manual override on rear; small monochrome LCD display showing battery and sensor diagnostics
distinctive_features: Central intake manifold with six converging sample ports—looks like a miniature factory smokestack
Translucent sensor pod showing layered analytical cartridges inside
Redundant motor configuration with visible heat-sink fins on each ESC unit
Reinforced landing gear with shock-absorbing gel pads—purpose-built for contaminated surfaces
Pulsing status beacon beneath the sensor pod, visible at altitude
physical_description.manufacturer_markings: VESPID DYNAMICS in white block lettering on both sides; ASD-5 model designation on port arm; regulatory certification stamps (GLMZ Environmental Authority approval) on undercarriage; small QR code on sensor pod linking to calibration history
physical_description.condition_typical: Often appears field-worn with fine dust coating the rotor blades and sensor intake vents; minor scuffing on motor arms from industrial deployment; accumulated particulate residue visible through translucent pod window requiring periodic cleaning
